related_work.title: Data-driven systematic parameter identification of an electrochemical model for lithium-ion batteries with artificial intelligence
related_work.relevance: Provides a framework for multi-step data-driven parameter identification of electrochemical models using artificial intelligence (cuckoo search algorithm) and multi-objective global optimization.

related_work.title: Parameter Identification of Lithium-Ion Batteries Model to Predict Discharge Behaviors Using Heuristic Algorithm
related_work.relevance: Proposes an efficient parameter identification method based on a heuristic algorithm (Genetic Algorithm) and a divide-and-conquer strategy for a pseudo-two-dimensional (P2D) model.
